views.markdown: Toggle StandBy on iOS even when not charging by triple-clicking the power button. This will override existing accessibility shortcuts.

*This is a **fork** of pookjw's [StandPad](https://github.com/pookjw/StandPad) that has been modified to force enable StandBy on iPhones. The power button triple-click logic was taken from wrp1002's [Flashlight Settings](https://github.com/wrp1002/FlashlightSettings)*
